def search(query, page_limit=20):
    out=[]
    i=0
    while True:
        resp=apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=access_token, query=query, page_index=i, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by='-updated_at', dont_reorder_pinned=False)
        print('page',i,'count',len(resp) if resp else None,'resp',resp)
        if not resp:
            break
        out.extend(resp)
        i+=1
        if i>50:
            break
    return out
